forms.name: Photo Mosaic Form
forms.description: Create a massive photographic collage mosaic using 1 central highlight image and 50 secondary supporting grid photos.

fields.label: Main Central Portrait Photo
fields.helpText: This will form the central prominent image visible over the collage. Upload 1 high-resolution photo.

fields.label: Supporting Mosaic Photos (50 required)
fields.helpText: Provide exactly 50 supporting images to render the underlying mosaic tile grid.

fields.label: Custom Greeting/Quote Text
fields.placeholder: e.g. Happy 25th Wedding Anniversary Mom & Dad!
fields.helpText: Printed on the bottom card border of the mosaic frame.

forms.name: Spotify Frame Form
forms.description: Personalised glass plaque with song details, a scannable Spotify track/playlist code, and a custom photo cover.

fields.label: Spotify Track or Playlist Link
fields.helpText: Used to generate the unique scannable play code on your frame.

fields.label: Album Art / Custom Image Cover
fields.helpText: This photo will replace the standard album cover art on the acrylic plaque.

fields.label: Optional Dedicated Custom QR Code Image
fields.helpText: Upload a custom design qr image if you have a pre-generated custom QR code.
